proposal.description: The run-window trip is counted as a strike as well as the hiccup entry it causes, so every hiccup out of S_RUN adds two strikes
proposal.reason: window_trip is high on the last S_RUN clock and hiccup_entry fires on the next, so each overcurrent hiccup from S_RUN raises strike_level by 2 instead of 1. That lengthens the cool-down chosen by hiccup_timer, and with MAX_STRIKES=3 latch_assert trips on the second run hiccup instead of the third.
